title: Rustic Bread
desc: A narrow beam of low morning sunlight pierces through the window of an artisanal bakery, falling onto a rough-hewn countertop of raw wood and matte stone. At the center of attention sits a vibrant sourdough loaf, featuring a blistered, caramelized crust and a moist, elastic crumb.
businessBrief: Focusing on raw textures and natural morning light, this sequence emphasizes authenticity and artisanal craft. An excellent narrative for organic bakeries, specialty flour mills, or lifestyle brands centered around slow living and wholesome ingredients.
